name: Kettlebell Hang Clean
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart holding one kettlebell at arm's length in front of your thighs with your thumb angled slightly inward.
Hinge back slightly at your hips, then drive your hips forward sharply while guiding your elbow close to your ribs to pull the kettlebell upward.
Rotate your hand smoothly around the handle to catch the bell gently in the front rack position against your forearm and chest.
Lower the kettlebell smoothly back down into the hang position, and switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Keep your elbow close to your torso so the kettlebell travels in a tight vertical path instead of looping outward.
Let your hand slide through the handle as the bell turns, then receive the bell softly against your forearm.
